transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Good to see you, Gloria. How is the right hip since two weeks ago?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Pain was 6 out of 10 then, and now it's 2 out of 10.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Getting out of the car is easy now. I still can't do the stairs at church without stopping.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hip internal rotation is 25 degrees on the right, and 35 on the left.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Hip abduction strength is 4/5 on the right, which is improving.

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I did the clamshells and bridges every day except Sunday.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Good. Last visit we added side-lying leg lifts. How are those?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hard but fine. My hip still clicks when I stand up.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: A click isn't a concern if it doesn't hurt. We'll keep an eye on it.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: Plan: I'm dropping the resistance band for two weeks so the hip can settle, and I'll keep the bridges at the same count.

transcript.speaker: clinician
transcript.text: I'll see you in two weeks and recheck strength at that visit.

expectedFacts.statement: Pain down from 6 out of 10 to 2 out of 10
Cannot do church stairs without stopping
Hip abduction strength 4/5 on the right
Clamshells and bridges every day except Sunday
Drop resistance band for two weeks
Recheck strength at visit in two weeks
